title: Facts carry their freshness at lookup: stamp, revalidation, gone repositories and per-section hashes
goal: Every pack prints an offline freshness stamp per cited source and marks unanchored or outdated lines; pack --revalidate and kb_pack revalidate check only the cited sources live and resolve only the printed lines' anchors, writing only _cache/; detect, the census and the revalidation report a pinned source of a repository that answers 404 as gone; and hash-only hosts are compared per heading section, so an edit elsewhere on a page leaves a fact's source unchanged
